invariants.rationale: No new Ecto schema modules, no new migrations, and no new lib/ code touching tenant-scoped tables — all new files are under test/; existing Router/Engine paths exercised through tests are already INV-1-scoped via :prefix.
No new API routes or response-serialisation code added; S4 not started and no multi-tenant response-shaping surface touched.
No Lua/WASM execution paths added or modified; S5 not started.

API tokens in the test actors map are ephemeral plaintext values resolved at runtime via Identity.create_token/3 — not hardcoded literals in source, not written to any file or persisted log; YAML fixture files contain no token literals; grep of lib/ and config/ for hardcoded secret patterns finds no new hits introduced by this diff.
No new lookup-by-ID endpoints; S4 not started.
This SECURITY-REVIEWER handoff exists, explicitly assesses INV-1..INV-9, and returns status PASS — the meta-invariant is satisfied.

The teardown helper in req206_swiftroute_test.exs uses Repo.query!(~s(DROP SCHEMA IF EXISTS "#{schema_name}" CASCADE)) — identical pattern to the already-reviewed lib/letflow/sandbox_pool.ex:975 and lib/letflow/tenant_provisioning.ex:273. schema_name is derived from TenantProvisioning.schema_name_for_tenant/1 which returns "tenant_" <> 32-char hex UUID — not user/tenant-controlled, not injectable. DDL statements (DROP SCHEMA) cannot accept parameterized placeholders in PostgreSQL; the value is system-generated and follows the same validated format (^tenant_[0-9a-f]{32}$) established and reviewed in prior passing runs. No Repo.query with interpolated user-supplied data was introduced in lib/ or priv/repo/migrations/.

Test setup uses with-chains and {:ok, _} = assertion-matches throughout (Seed.seed_company/1, Seed.seed_users/2, Identity.create_token/3, TenantProvisioning.schema_name_for_tenant/1); Runner.run/1 returns {:ok, report} | {:error, term()} and test assertions match that shape — no bare pattern-match on an external-I/O call that could crash a shared process.
No outbound HTTP requests added; the harness dispatches through Letflow.Router.call/2 (in-process Plug.Test, no network), and no webhook subscription or URL-resolution path was added.
